sources.title: Ornith 1.0 — Open-Source Agentic Coding Models
sources.snippet: Ornith 1.0 is a family of open-source large language models built by DeepReinforce AI specifically for agentic coding. Released on June 25, 2026, Ornith 1.0 spans four parameter sizes — 9B Dense, 31B Dense, 35B MoE, and 397B MoE — all under MIT license with no regional restrictions.

sources.title: How to Run Ornith 1.5 9B Locally: GGUF, Hardware and Benchmarks
sources.snippet: Ornith 1.5 9B is the dense vision-language model this guide is about, and the smallest of the three: it fits an 8 GB GPU or a 16 GB MacBook, the cheapest way to run Ornith locally.
